title: Common-stage inclusion preserves the forward open pullback/tensor square
statement: For the same data as lem-sf-common-projection-open-pullback-tensor, the forward square commutes: inclusion maps the rational open tensor/pullback comparison, then the common tensorator and the common pullback, equal the coefficient pullback comparison, then the common tensorator at the pullback and the common open tensor/pullback comparison. The exact Lean endpoints are the statement of commonProjectionOpenPullbackTensor_forward.

source.place: Compatibility and the common finite coefficient-field paragraph: flat extension of scalars respects the units, counits, associativity and specified projection mate.

proof.text: This is the forward representative equation for the inverse square. It is obtained by evaluating the canonical common-stage pullback/tensor representative formula at the included pair and substituting the rational and common normalization equalities. The remaining transition maps cancel by naturality and the scalar unit.

lean.statement:
theorem commonProjectionOpenPullbackTensor_forward
    {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A] {B : Type v'} [Category.{w'} B]
    {A' : Type v} [Category.{w} A'] {B' : Type v'} [Category.{w'} B']
    {F : A ⥤ B} {F' : A' ⥤ B'} {c : A ⥤ A'} {d : B ⥤ B'}
    (e : F ⋙ d ≅ c ⋙ F')
    (TA : A × A ⥤ A) (TB : B × B ⥤ B)
    (TA' : A' × A' ⥤ A') (TB' : B' × B' ⥤ B')
    (tA : TA ⋙ c ≅ c.prod c ⋙ TA')
    (tB : TB ⋙ d ≅ d.prod d ⋙ TB')
    (M N : A) (mu : F.obj (TA.obj (M, N)) ⟶ TB.obj (F.obj M, F.obj N))
    (mu' : F'.obj (TA'.obj (c.obj M, c.obj N)) ⟶
      TB'.obj (F'.obj (c.obj M), F'.obj (c.obj N))) :
    d.map mu ≫ tB.hom.app (F.obj M, F.obj N) ≫
        TB'.map (Prod.mkHom (e.hom.app M) (e.hom.app N)) =
      e.hom.app (TA.obj (M, N)) ≫ F'.map (tA.hom.app (M, N)) ≫ mu'
